t: A Polynesian kingdom created by the Pōmare family, who used European guns and allies to rise above Tahiti’s rival chiefs from about 1788.
Pōmare II’s victory at Fei Pi in 1815 made Tahiti a Christian kingdom, with Polynesia’s first written law code in 1819.
Anglo-French rivalry led to a French protectorate in 1842, a war in 1844–1847 and annexation by France in 1880.
dyk: The landing of the first London Missionary Society missionaries at Matavai Bay on 5 March 1797 is still a public holiday in French Polynesia, the Arrivée de l’Évangile.
ev: William Bligh’s HMS Bounty arrives at Matavai Bay to collect breadfruit plants
Tu’s son, the future Pōmare II, is invested with the red-feathered maro ‘ura
London Missionary Society missionaries land from the Duff at Matavai Bay
Pōmare II defeats the chiefs of the old religion at the Battle of Fei Pi
Pōmare II issues Tahiti’s first written law code and is baptised
Pōmare IV signs a request for French protection under threat of bombardment
Tahitians resist French rule in the Franco-Tahitian War
Pōmare V cedes Tahiti and its dependencies to France
